review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Catalog Store
review_candidates.description: We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Overview Instacart is powered by a robust set of cloud services, and every product a customer searches for, browses, or adds to their cart is served from storage systems the Catalog Store team builds and runs. We own the low-latency, application-facing storage and retrieval platform behind Instacart's product catalog, serving Search, Ads, shopper and customer apps, and AI systems across the company. Our platform includes sharded self-hosted PostgreSQL clusters, a high-frequency Go RPC service, Temporal-based ingestion pipelines, and a new in-house in-memory key-value store built for read-heavy workloads. This role is based in Canada (Toronto preferred) and is open to remote work in Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia and Nova Scotia. About The Job If you're excited by distributed systems at scale, real-time data challenges, and opportunities to shape the future of AI-powered commerce, this team offers a chance for outsized impact in a fast-paced environment: You will be a senior engineer on a small team with a large amount of ownership and autonomy, reporting to an engineering manager and partnering closely with the team's tech lead on technical direction. You will work in an AI-empowered environment, using and helping to shape the latest AI tools for research, development and operations. You will lead projects end to end, from ambiguous problem to design, implementation, production rollout and operation, across Catalog Store services and datastores, including critical Go RPCs, PostgreSQL, in-memory key-value stores, and distributed datastore technologies. You will own the health and evolution of our self-hosted PostgreSQL fleet on AWS EC2: sharding and replica topology, capacity planning, backups and restores, schema and index tuning, upgrades, and retiring legacy clusters. You will drive new datastore systems to production, from ingestion and data freshness to migrating APIs onto them with shadow testing, staged rollouts and clear deprecation plans. You will optimize and harden our Temporal-based ingestion workflows that keep catalog data fresh, reliable and observable. You will write and review design documents, make sound technical trade-offs, and drive alignment with partner teams across other Instacart pillars. You will raise the bar for reliability through strong observability, SLOs, automation and runbooks, take part in the team's on-call rotation, and lead incident response and follow-up for systems you own. You will mentor other engineers, raise code quality through thoughtful review, and help onboard new teammates. Instacart's technology is constantly changing and adapting. Some of the technologies you would use at Instacart include: Languages: Go (primary), Python, Rust and Ruby Datastores & Platforms: PostgreSQL (self-hosted on EC2), key-value stores like Redis, Valkey and Memcached, distributed databases like Yugabyte, and other software platform systems such as Temporal, Snowflake, S3, Terraform Observability and Analytics: Datadog, Sentry and Snowflake If you have experience with these technologies, you will have the opportunity to dive deeper. If you haven't used these technologies you will have the chance to learn from the collective experience of our team. About You Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating backend services or distributed systems in large-scale cloud environments Strong production experience in Go, or deep production experience in another backend or systems language (e.g., Java, C++, Rust) and willingness to work primarily in Go Deep hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, such as data modeling & lifecycle, schema and index design, query performance tuning, replication, backups and restores Experience designing for scale, reliability and performance in distributed systems, including low-latency services and caching Track record of independently leading projects end to end, from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, rollout and operation, including work that involves other engineers or teams Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Preferred Qualifications Experience operating services on AWS (e.g., EC2, S3) or another major cloud, including infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform Production operations experience: observability (metrics, logs, traces), on-call participation, incident response and postmortems Experience building or operating low-latency, high-throughput RPC services (gRPC or similar) Experience self-hosting databases or other core infrastructure, including sharded or replicated clusters and fleet automation Experience mentoring engineers and raising the bar on code quality and best practices through code and design reviews Clear written and verbal communication, including design documents, with a demonstrated ability to drive alignment across teams and stakeholders An ability to balance a sense of urgency with shipping high quality, pragmatic solutions Experience leading datastore or similar platform transformation initiatives with zero downtime, such as dual writes, shadow reads, backfills and staged traffic ramps Familiarity with key-value or in-memory datastores (e.g., Valkey, Redis, Memcached) or distributed SQL databases (e.g., Yugabyte, CockroachDB) Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal) or data pipelines from warehouses like Snowflake A track record of measurable impact on latency, availability or cloud cost Experience applying AI tools to speed up development and operations, or building AI-assisted tooling for your team Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here. For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CAN $168,000—$177,500 CAD

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Operations (f/m/d)
review_candidates.description: As a Senior Software Engineer – Operations (f/m/d) , you will build and improve the integrations that connect KoRo's internal systems with external partners and platforms. You will take ownership of critical backend services and data flows across ERP, logistics, finance, and e-commerce, ensuring they are reliable, secure, and scalable. Working closely with Engineering and business teams, you will drive technical improvements and contribute to high engineering standards. What you will do: Backend Development & Integrations: You design, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations connecting internal systems with external partners and platforms. Technical Ownership: You take end-to-end responsibility for selected integration domains, ensuring reliable performance, maintainability, and continuous improvement. Architecture & Standards: You improve system architecture, automate critical workflows, and contribute to clean, scalable, and maintainable engineering solutions. Code Quality & Best Practices: You conduct code reviews, ensure high coding standards, and identify potential issues related to performance, security, and maintainability. System Reliability: You troubleshoot complex production issues, identify root causes, and improve monitoring, alerting, and automated testing to prevent recurring problems. Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work closely with engineering and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions and share knowledge with junior and mid-level engineers. What you bring: 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, with strong expertise in PHP, Symfony, REST and GraphQL APIs, system integrations, and asynchronous processing using message queues (e.g. RabbitMQ). Hands-on experience with Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, GitHub Container Registry, and automated testing frameworks such as PHPUnit or Pest. Strong understanding of software architecture, clean code principles, and distributed systems, with experience building reliable, scalable applications. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to take technical ownership, collaborate across teams, and support other engineers. Experience with high-volume data processing, asynchronous message queues, and building and maintaining data pipelines and event-driven systems. Excellent written and spoken English skills Nice to have: Experience with Temporal, RoadRunner, Testcontainers, or OpenTelemetry. Familiarity with OAuth 2.0 and e-commerce platforms such as Shopware What's in it for you: Smart Working & Flexibility: Flexible working hours, hybrid work, and 20 days of workation. We trust you to take ownership: you deliver on our shared goals and structure your day in the way that works best for you. You’ll also start with 28 days of vacation, increasing by one additional day per year of tenure (capped at 30 days), so you always have time to recharge. Growth & Setup: A structured onboarding plan to get you started, plus a dedicated development budget for your personal and professional growth. You’ll also receive your own MacBook and a fully equipped office setup with monitors and height-adjustable desks. KoRo Life & Extras: Free snacks and barista coffee in the office, 20% discount in the KoRo Online-Shop, and exclusive perks with partner companies. On top of that, a fully funded BVG ticket (Jobticket), a subsidy for your fitness membership (Urban Sports Club, Hansefit, or FitX), and a company pension scheme (bAV) via Ginkgo. Shared Moments: Regular team events and company parties to celebrate milestones and successes together. We're looking for People who share our Mindset For us, it's not just about the what , but above all about the how . You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset: You take initiative and ownership. You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked. You thrive in change. Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving. You build, you don't wait. When something is missing - a tool, a process, a solution - you create it. You prefer a working MVP over a perfect plan and iterate from there. You think in leverage. You question how things are done, prioritize ruthlessly, and find smarter paths to better outcomes. You don't mistake effort for impact. You're a team player, humble and genuinely kind. You collaborate in and across teams, care about the people around you, and bring sparkles to the room. You speak up when you disagree, commit fully once a decision is made, and actively make the people around you better. Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others Sounds good? Then we’d love to hear from you! Send us your CV and tell us a little about yourself in a few introductory sentences – who you are, what drives you, and why you’d like to become part of KoRo. After all, we’re looking for team members, not just co-workers! The KoRo team is just as diverse as our product range! We want to keep it that way as our nut-loving team grows. That’s why we welcome all applicants regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. Ready to join KoRo? We look forward to hearing from you!

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Corporate Actions & Security Master
review_candidates.description: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineer on the Reference Data team, you will build services that form the data backbone of Alpaca’s brokerage infrastructure. Almost every service at Alpaca needs information about the assets it operates on. Our team provides that information and supports the events that affect those assets throughout their lifecycle. The team owns two core areas: Security Master , the central source of information about tradable assets, their characteristics and whether, when, and how they can be traded; and corporate actions , which involves ingesting third-party information about dividends, stock splits, mergers and other events, then calculating the changes and transactions needed to reflect them in customer and partner holdings. You will work across both areas, helping Alpaca enter new markets, expand its portfolio of products and improve the reliability, performance and operability of existing systems. This is a hands-on backend engineering role focused on distributed systems, data modelling and correctness across interconnected services. You will take open-ended problems from scoping and design through implementation, rollout and production support, working closely with the teams that depend on reference data. Things You Get To Do Design, build and maintain distributed backend services, APIs and data models for Security Master and corporate actions. Extend reference data systems to support new instruments, asset classes and market-specific requirements, including futures and prediction markets. Build reliable workflows for ingesting, validating and processing third-party instrument and corporate action information. Develop internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and improve the reliability of reference data operations. Help redesign how foundational asset information is structured and shared across Alpaca, contributing to architectural decisions with company-wide impact. Work closely with engineering and business teams that consume reference data, coordinating changes across services. Own complex features and technical decisions from design through production, including testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Who You Are (Must-Haves) Strong experience building and operating event-driven, distributed backend systems. Strong database and data-modelling skills, with an understanding of eventual consistency and data replication. Excellent system design fundamentals, including designing and evolving APIs. Proficiency in a strongly typed programming language and willingness to work in Go. Experience taking complex or ambiguous problems from initial requirements through delivery and production operation. Ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, collaborate across teams and reason through cross-system dependencies. Senior-level engineering judgement and ownership; we assess capability and impact rather than applying a fixed years-of-experience threshold. Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves) Experience in trading, brokerage, capital markets, crypto infrastructure or related financial technology. Experience with reference data, Security Master, instrument or asset data, or corporate action processing. Understanding of financial instruments, particularly options, futures and other derivatives. Experience with third-party data ingestion, internal tooling and workflow automation. Experience guiding other engineers and working across interconnected services and teams. How We Take Care of You: Competitive Salary & Stock Options Health Benefits New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500 Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. Recruitment Privacy Policy

We’re an eleven-engineer team approaching launch, looking for a resourceful developer who wants meaningful ownership and difficult technical problems. Professional experience is welcome, but it isn’t required. Personal projects, independent learning and work you’ve built yourself count. We care about your programming ability, how quickly you learn and how you solve problems. What you’ll do - Build and improve 3D systems. - Investigate technical problems, develop solutions and take them through implementation. - Improve performance, reliability and visual results. - Work directly with the founders and engineers as we prepare for launch and grow the product. Who we’re looking for - You write code and have practical experience building something in 3D. - You can explain your technical decisions and your contribution to a project. - You learn unfamiliar tools quickly and work through problems independently. - You take responsibility, communicate clearly and finish what you start. - You want a demanding, long-term role on a small team. We’ll discuss the weekly schedule during interviews.
